notes.title: URLate - Update 1.5.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I've just released a small update for URLate (version 1.5.0.3). 
This patch fixes a bug related to empty inventory slots, which could cause unexpected behavior when interacting with certain items.

Thanks, as always, for playing and for your feedback — it really helps me keep improving!

notes.title: URLate – Update 1.5.0.2

Hi everyone!

notes.title: URLate - Update 1.5.0.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I've released version 1.5.0.1 of URLate, with a few fixes:


 English descriptions: All objects now display their full text.
 Backpack collision: Fixed an issue that prevented proper interaction with a specific object.


Thank you for playing and for your feedback! ❤️
